answer: Commit-reveal orbital photometry mitigates Sybil attacks in an agent economy by binding each node to a distinct ground resolution cell. On challenge, a node commits hashed reflectance in saffron and jade bands, capturing fleeting solar shifts over terrain like a dune before satellite telemetry downlinks. Faking extra accounts requires separate radiometers and physical land plots per identity. Still, cloud cover or blowing dust can obscure albedo and disrupt honest verification.
